## Use Server Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Server Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Server Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Server Mono coding font

A typewriter- and CLI-inspired monospace from Internet Development. Server Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Server Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Server Mono FAQ

### Is Server Mono free?

Yes. Server Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Server Mono support ligatures?

No. Server Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Server Mono?

Server Mono is available from GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
